title: Clearing or replacing a session's shared Codex runtime drops its still-running Codex tests' record without proving their commands ended
outcome: When a session leaves the shared Codex app-server (Stop, runtime replacement, or an interrupt that failed and detached), a Codex test it left running from an earlier turn either keeps its still-running record (EngramSessionState::running_codex_tests) until an end is confirmed, with the holder told how to release it, or is ended by a kill the app-server confirms before the record is dropped. In both cases a check started afterwards in its worktree is overlapped until then. The kill is a new destructive act and needs Greg's explicit word before it is built.
acceptance: A probe note, from the installed Codex, records whether thread/unsubscribe, thread/archive or thread/delete ends a thread's still-running exec session, with the event or process evidence observed.

With the fix chosen and, for a kill, Greg's recorded word: a test drives a carried Codex test and then a Stop or runtime replacement, and shows either a confirmed end before its still-running record is dropped, or the record kept, the holder told, and a check started afterwards in its worktree overlapped with it named.
A test covers a Stop whose interrupt fails, with the same outcome as criterion 2.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
